summary: Associates the drawing's point and command mappings with the selected IED configuration revision.
description: Associates the drawing's point and command mappings with the selected IED configuration revision. Station automation collects measurements and statuses and issues assigned commands through defined authority paths. A communicated point has a value, quality and equipment identity; it should not be treated as an unexplained contact.

In a substation control building, the station controller receives bay information and forwards an operator's selected command to the correct bay device. Device feedback confirms whether the intended result actually occurred. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Drawing signal map” at the input and “Configuration revision link” at the output. The referenced revision must match the installed system.
